rows.TEXT: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

Virimos 
"True, Mortis no longer whispers.she screams! Her voice pounds within my head, longing for the punishment of her foul husband. She demands the blood of Gallean's children."

"You seek to invade the Elvesss? Madnesss! We are strong, but."

Virimos 
"Fear not, Prusheen. Mortis knows what must be done! One day she may choose to speak with you again, but until that time, you will obey my commands."

"There! Without their primitive figurehead, the superstitious Barbarians will be too shocked to cause us much more distraction. A shame, though...their dead make formidable additions to the hordes. But where is the key?"

"Key? I don't know about any key."

Barbarian Chieftain

Virimos 
"To think such power is imbued in a trinket! Very good, savage...very good indeed. For your cooperation I grant you a prolonged death. Do feel free to cry out."

Virimos 
"Prusheen, I have a task for you, sent by Mortis herself."

Virimos 
"You are to lead an expedition to the north to deceive the Clans. You will convince them that you are sent directly from their precious Wotan, and sway them into battle with the Elves."

Virimos 
"Ah, yes, I would have to explain it to you, wouldn't I? You will use the barbarian talismans to disguise yourselves as 'holy' wolves, which should be sufficient to trick the mindless Dwarves."

Virimos 
"I will lead my own party there as well, to attack the Dwarves. You will step in and drive us away before delivering your message. I have confidence that you will have no problem playing the role of a dog."
Objective: Lead Prusheen's pack of wolves to meet with the Clans.

Tirumn

"We have taken the city, Lord Virimos. However, we only succeeded in slaying a lesser chieftain in the Barbarian order. We now know that Chief Yorjagg is the primary power in their tribes, but we do not know where he dwells."

Virimos 
"Well you'd better find and remove him quickly. We have more important things to worry about than flea-bitten savages. Cut off the head and the body crumbles."

Virimos 
"Only Prusheen's pack in disguise must approach the dwarven outpost, otherwise the plan will not succeed. Now hurry, we haven't much time!"

Prusheen

"I've seen it with my own eyes! The spirits of Wotan walk among us! I am not worthy of such an honor! Why have you come to us, great wolves?"

Prusheen 
"The foul Elven god, Gallean, hasss returned. Wotan wasss rid of him once, but fleshlesss Mortisss has revived him. Wotan will ssspeak to you all, but great power must be gathered to allow thisss to happen."

Mountaineer 
"Damnation! Our lands are destroyed, our people scattered! How can we hope to oppose yet another god now? But we will hear Wotan's voice? I'd never have dreamed we'd be the chosen generation...yes, this is what we need to reunite the Clans!"

Prusheen

Nith 
"I've been waiting for you. I have the information Virimos requested. There is a small Clans outpost in the North and although it is close to the Dwarven capital, it is merely a scouting point. The defenses are negligible."

Nith 
"What you do with this information is not my concern. You may seek me again at other places of trade, and perhaps, once I have served my purpose, release me from my agonizing undeath. No, of course not - how could I expect mercy from you?"

Nith 
"If you're seeking the outpost, you should know that there is an impassable mountainous wall north of here, sealed by Dwarven magic. I've discovered that there was once a key to bypass the seal, given to the elder barbarian tribes to open trade."

Nith 
"I would think that Yorjagg, the Barbarian high chief, might possess this key. I will continue scouting the Dwarves. You may run into me again at other merchants."

Nith 
"I see you've finally made it. You are very close now. You'll travel through a dense forest to the west and then you'll see the outpost. It's a tower seated amidst the rubble from Mendros Mine."

Nith 
"I suppose I could use this opportunity to plead for my death, but we all know how pointless that would be. I will fade into the shadows as usual. You will, unfortunately, see me again."

Virimos 
"Excellent! The key has opened a path directly into Dwarven territory! We must make haste!"

Yorjagg 
"Come, crooked ones! Come and let Yorjagg put you back in your graves! Hahahahah!"

Nith

Nith 
"I've been watching the Barbarians to the west. It's unusual, but it seems that the primitive giant tribes have joined their forces. This means we can expect to lose quite a few of our numbers when we attack their stronghold."

Nith 
"Maybe if I am lucky, I will be on the front lines. No, you'll send me off to snoop in some horrible place instead, no doubt. If you need to reach me, I usually do my scouting at places where money changes hands."

Nith
